pages.title: Making Desichalkos
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Eximite + 1 Meutoite = 2 Desichalkos

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 2232 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 6.$(br)Mining efficiency: 10.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 3.7.$(br)Enchantability: 21.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 5, leggings 4, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 2.5.$(br)Enchantability: 21.

pages.title: Tool: Wormhole
pages.text: Tool Reach is 3 blocks higher than normal (Metal trait) - Block Drops are teleported to the player inventory directly

pages.title: Weapon: Nullifier
pages.text: When attacking, the damage is dealt straight to the opponent's health bar, unaffected by armor or any resistance the opponent might have.

pages.title: Armor: Orb
pages.text: The wearer can fully absorb X instances of damage (X scales with armor) without taking damage, the “Layers” regenerate one at a time every 7 seconds after the last time the wearer took damage.
